The Future of Web Development

Published on January 15, 2024 by Jane Smith

Web development continues to evolve with new technologies and standards. The W3C recently announced updates to several key specifications.

Semantic HTML is crucial for accessibility and SEO. According to Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1, proper semantic markup helps screen readers understand page structure.

The term semantic HTML refers to using HTML elements that convey meaning about the content they contain.

days.title: Day 3 – Web Components and Custom Elements
days.definition: Web Components are a set of web platform APIs that allow you to create reusable custom elements with encapsulated functionality and styling.

explanation.main: Web Components enable building framework-agnostic, reusable UI components.

days.code_example:

4. Accordion Component

Web Components are a set of web platform APIs that allow you to create new custom, reusable, encapsulated HTML tags to use in web pages and web apps.
  • Custom Elements: Define new HTML elements
  • Shadow DOM: Encapsulated DOM and styling
  • HTML Templates: Reusable markup structures

Web Components are supported in all modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge.
days.real_world_example: Web Components are used by Google (Material Web Components), Salesforce (Lightning Web Components), GitHub (some UI elements), and in design systems for creating reusable component libraries that work across different frameworks like React, Vue, and Angular.

quiz.question: What are the three main technologies of Web Components?
options: Custom Elements, Shadow DOM, HTML Templates
quiz.answer: Custom Elements, Shadow DOM, HTML Templates
quiz.reasoning: Web Components consist of Custom Elements, Shadow DOM, and HTML Templates. (Reference: MDN Web Components)

quiz.question: Which method registers a custom element?
quiz.reasoning: customElements.define() registers a new custom element. (Reference: MDN CustomElementRegistry.define)

quiz.question: What does Shadow DOM provide?
quiz.reasoning: Shadow DOM provides style and markup encapsulation. (Reference: MDN Shadow DOM)

quiz.question: Which lifecycle method is called when element is added to DOM?
quiz.reasoning: connectedCallback() is called when element is connected to DOM. (Reference: MDN connectedCallback)

quiz.question: How to watch for attribute changes?
quiz.reasoning: static observedAttributes array defines which attributes to watch. (Reference: MDN observedAttributes)
